name: Karachi
notes: Buildings, storeys, land use, streets, water, and the substations come from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL).
Population: 2023 Census of Pakistan (PBS), Karachi Division, spread over residential floor area.
50 % of buildings have no storey count in OpenStreetMap; theirs is estimated from tagged neighbours.

Service areas are split by nearest grid substation, not from real feeder maps. Only 6 grid substations inside the city are mapped in OpenStreetMap (the real network has many more), so each area is large.
Cars: about 100 per 1,000 people, 1 % of them electric today (approximate).
Karachi has bus rapid transit but no metro yet.
Scaled so a summer weekday peaks at 3,563 MW, K-Electric’s peak in June 2025 (K-Electric 2025 review). Its service area takes in some adjoining towns.

hospital.name: Civil Hospital
hospital.source: Civil Hospital: 2000 beds (Express Tribune, 2026, reporting the Sindh government expansion plan from 2,000 to 2,500 beds); location from OpenStreetMap; peak load estimated at 5 kW per bed.
